purpose: Establish whether stronger local inference completes predefined upstream collaboration examples, then attribute costs before proposing KV transfer
source_policy: Use the entire original sample.txt and task question, no truncation, retrieval, reordering, padding or reference-answer prompt
controls: Independent full-context direct local and remote answers for every case
Independent question-only local and remote answers for long_documents and finance
Short code sample full-vs-chunked final-position logits on both real models

quality_adjudication.protocol: Record returned final answer vs protocol exception separately from answer correctness
quality_adjudication.code: Compare explicitly identified buggy-method set against upstream four-method reference; mention-only matching is not accuracy; reference semantics may be underspecified
quality_adjudication.long_documents: Final answer must identify FinanceBench, LongHealth and QASPER as the three evaluation datasets; a matching no-document control weakens evidence of document dependence
quality_adjudication.finance: Answer must identify 2019 net property/equipment as 72,705 million USD, or equivalent rounded 72.7 billion; mere incidental numeric occurrence is insufficient
quality_adjudication.truncation: Report all length-capped outputs; do not silently extend budgets after inspecting quality

cost_interpretation: Report observed full prefill and remaining generation separately. Same-endpoint exact-prefix eligibility is not measured cache benefit. No speedup claim from failed tasks, single cold measurements, or weak uncached serving baselines.
scope_limits: Three examples are not benchmark accuracy or OSDI-level validation
Public source documents do not establish local-only necessity
Two-round collaboration is upstream Q&A protocol, not a device action workflow
No new state-transfer mechanism or privacy guarantee is implemented
